title: Soft and sturdy at the same time
text: Soft and sturdy at the same time. I purchased this after having purchased some other lower quality peshtemals and I am very happy with it. It’s light without being too light and the size is perfect for using as a towel or to put over my yoga mat or my lounge chair to keep my dog’s fluff off the chair fabric.  You can also tie it several ways to wear it as a dress or a sarong at the beach and it makes a great beach towel.
